change: Item 2 of docs/UD-OPTIMIZED-ROUTE-PLAN.md. Three dense T16 role/shape allowlists were written against the plain Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_S file, which carries no tensor at the roles the UD files use, so those UD tensors fell to the raw/pack8 GEMV layouts. Q5_K's _is_dense_h5120_q5_t16_tensor grows from 3 roles to the full 9-role dense set (matching _DENSE_Q4_T16_SIDECAR_POLICY); Q6_K's wide predicate gains ffn_up/attn_output/ssm_out and its narrow predicate gains attn_k beside attn_v; Q4_K's sidecar policy gains ssm_out (5120, 6144), the same geometry as attn_output.
why_this_is_safe_to_widen: Every predicate reads 'select only the measured ...' - measurement scope, not kernel capability. Each remaining tensor was verified T16-alignable through the planner's own _planned_t16_nbytes before the change, and every newly admitted (role, shape) pair was already admitted for Q4_K on the identical H5120 geometry.

numerics.movement: mean +2.7%, p95 -10.2% (better), p99 +13.3%, max +16.4%, one top-1 position lost
numerics.top1_flip_analysis: The single flip is position 26 (prompt 2, step 8), where the teacher's own distribution is nearly tied: p(token 1445)=0.475540 against p(token 1005)=0.473468, a gap of 2.07e-03. The prior arm's margin there was 4.9e-03 and it happened to fall on the teacher's side; the new arm's is 3.03e-02 on the other. At a 0.2% teacher gap, which side an arm lands on is close to arbitrary, so the 162/162 -> 161/162 move is not read as a quality regression - but the prior default's 'best top-1 measured' distinction is given up and that is recorded rather than glossed.
numerics.strict_thresholds: mean/p95/p99 remain above the strict thresholds, the pre-existing campaign state; the measured hipEngine-BF16-KV vs teacher-F16-KV floor (mean 0.000415) accounts for a substantial part of the mean excess
